messages:
mia.h: OrionLabs POC seeing inconsistent TTFT (0.2s -> 2.8s) and a cluster of 429s during burst tests. Need quick triage before presales call at 3pm.
ryan.b: Which model/route and can you paste a minimal repro?
mia.h: route: /v1/generate model=redwood-gamma prompt_len=6. Repro curl: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-gamma","input":"Ping"}'`
pavan: Any request ids or gateway headers? Look for `x-rw-queue` and `x-rw-throttle`.
mia.h: request ids: req_o1c2d3 (2210004332), req_o1c2d7 (2210004358). Gateway shows `x-rw-queue: q-3` and `x-rw-throttle: true` on the slow ones. App logs: `kv-prefill: miss key=conv/9834` and `batch-window: 8ms`.
ryan.b: 8ms + ~70 concurrent single-token calls -> micro-batching thrash. Causes worker context switching and can hit rate limiter buckets. Do they rotate session IDs per message?
mia.h: Yes, they rotate session ids every message for privacy. Security team asked about that.
pavan: Short-term: 1) increase batching window to 30ms for their route, 2) enable sticky-affinity to reduce cross-worker warmups, 3) enable account-scoped ephemeral cache token with 60s TTL (non-identifying). Ops required for routing change.
nicole-sec: On security: ephemeral account-scoped tokens are OK if they contain no PII and are auditable. Draft wording: "Redwood supports ephemeral account-scoped cache tokens (non-identifying) with short TTLs to enable performance caching while preserving user privacy; tokens are rotated and logged for audit."
ops-bot: ops-bot: Routing/sticky change requested by pavan	6 applied: orionlabs-account -> pool-burst-2, sticky=true (2210004360).
mia.h: After routing bump + batching window increase median TTFT improved from 0.72s -> 0.22s; 95th from 2.8s -> 0.75s. 429s dropped ~70%. Still see first-request kv-prefill misses.
pavan: Prefill misses expected with per-message session churn. For longer term: 1) Dedicated reserved capacity (removes shared token buckets), 2) encourage client-side mini-batching in SDK, 3) server-side prefix caching for common prompts.
ryan.b: Client asked procurement pricing for a 30-day Dedicated trial. Lia from sales will send an estimated commit. For POC we typically offer a discounted 14-30 day pilot.
mia.h: Can SRE and security join today's 3pm presales call to sign-off on ephemeral cache approach?
nicole-sec: I'll join and bring the draft security blurb.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Monitoring checkpoint created for orionlabs-account: alert if 429 rate > 10% for 15m (2210004388).
mia.h: Thanks all, I'll update CRM with request ids req_o1c2d3, req_o1c2d7 and link to perf charts. :phone:
